scope: Adapter TagDuel isolado para Swords of Revealing Light e Dark-Piercing Light: revelar monstros face-down da equipe adversária, lock de ataques durante os três End Phases adversários para Swords, expiração idempotente, ownership físico e conservação de UID. Sem integração ao resolver central, catálogo, certificações, comandos, banco, inventário ou produção.

cards.name: Swords of Revealing Light
cards.officialText: After this card's activation, it remains on the field, but you must destroy it during the End Phase of your opponent's 3rd turn. When this card is activated: If your opponent controls a face-down monster, flip all monsters they control face-up. While this card is face-up on the field, your opponent's monsters cannot declare an attack.

cards.name: Dark-Piercing Light
cards.officialText: Flip all face-down monsters on your opponent's side of the field face-up.

implementation.scope: Adapter isolado e regressões offline; os eventos Flip resultantes são retornados ao host, não executados dentro da Chain pelo adapter.
